DOING THINGS PURELY OUT OF PERSONAL INTEREST

Have not posted the colorized images on any other paid platforms (including but not limited to Patreon, FanBox, DeviantArt),
and if you have purchased on other paid platforms, I have nothing to do with any disputes.

This [ダシガラ100%(民兵一号)] 大波に乗ろう! (ワンピース) translation of other versions, modifications, decensored, etc... I did not participate in.
If you have any disputes with other production teams about commissioned translations, coloring, or decensored, it is none of my business.
Please do not send any further messages asking questions or queries.

The original plan to re-color [ダシガラ100% (民兵一号)] 大波に乗ろう! (ワンピース) , Due to some people's reasons, the project was stopped.
I'm sorry for this, Dr. Deathhh. Sincerely sorry.
